reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited § 12.3 (p0049) squarely supports it: it affirms Customer may hire any person responding to general recruitment and that Customer has made no no-hire commitment, matching the rule's preferred position of no non-solicit on Customer.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; any edit here would introduce a restriction adverse to our client.

The failed deterministic checks (12-month duration, general-solicitation carve-out) are non-probative because they presuppose an existing covenant binding Customer; there is no such covenant to narrow, so the regex misses are phrasing/context artifacts rather than defects.

Rationale documents a reasonable search (no hits for 'solicit' or 'induce'; 'personnel' clauses allocate Vendor staff responsibility rather than restrict our hiring), supporting the absence conclusion.
